title: Fix media visibility: videos, photos, and posts not rendering on feed, explore, and profile pages

requirements.summary: Fix PostCard component so that image and video media attached to posts is correctly rendered and visible
acceptanceCriteria: Image posts display their image in PostCard on the feed, explore, and profile pages
Video posts display their video thumbnail and play correctly in PostCard
Posts with no media render cleanly without broken image/video placeholders

file_operations.description: Fix media rendering by ensuring ExternalBlob instances are converted to displayable URLs using getDirectURL() method. For image posts (mediaType starts with 'image'), render an img element with src set to media.getDirectURL(). For video posts (mediaType starts with 'video'), render a video element with src set to media.getDirectURL(). Add null/undefined checks for media field and only render media elements when post.media exists and post.mediaType is truthy. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fix ProfilePage so that the current user's posts grid correctly fetches and displays all posts including those with images and videos
acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated user's ProfilePage shows all their posts in the posts grid
Post thumbnails (images/videos) are visible in the profile grid
Liked posts tab also renders post media correctly

file_operations.description: Ensure the posts grid renders post media correctly by passing the post objects to PostCard or by rendering thumbnail images/videos directly. For the posts grid, if rendering thumbnails directly, use post.media?.getDirectURL() as the img or video src. Ensure both 'My Posts' and 'Liked Posts' tabs correctly display media thumbnails. Verify that useGetPostsByUser is called with the correct principal (identity.getPrincipal()) and that the resulting posts array includes media fields. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fix UserProfilePage so that any public user's posts grid fetches and displays all posts including those with images and videos
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting another user's profile shows all their posts with media visible
No broken image/video placeholders appear in the posts grid

file_operations.description: Ensure the posts grid fetches posts using either principalId or handle route parameters and renders post media correctly. When rendering post thumbnails, use post.media?.getDirectURL() as the img or video src. Verify that the route parameter extraction and profile/posts fetching logic correctly resolves the user by principal or handle. Ensure posts with media display their thumbnails in the grid. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fix ShortSportPage so that video posts are fetched and rendered with working playback
acceptanceCriteria: Short videos load and play in the ShortSportPage vertical feed
Video thumbnail/poster is visible before playback begins
Mute/unmute and play/pause controls work correctly

file_operations.description: Fix video rendering in the vertical feed by ensuring each video element's src attribute is set using post.media?.getDirectURL(). Ensure that video elements have proper controls (play/pause, mute/unmute) wired to state and that the video ref correctly points to the HTML video element. Add null checks for post.media before calling getDirectURL(). Verify that the intersection observer and auto-play logic work correctly with the fixed video sources. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Fix ExplorePage so that posts returned by useGetAllPosts render their media correctly
acceptanceCriteria: Explore page post grid shows image and video content for all posts
No broken media placeholders appear on the explore page

file_operations.description: Ensure that the posts grid on the 'Browse' tab renders media correctly by passing post objects to PostCard or by rendering thumbnails with post.media?.getDirectURL() as the src. Verify that useGetAllPosts is called and that the resulting posts array includes media fields. Ensure that media thumbnails are visible in the explore grid. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

requirements.summary: Audit and fix the ExternalBlob rendering utility to ensure binary blob data is correctly converted to displayable URLs
acceptanceCriteria: Blobs fetched from the backend are converted to valid displayable URLs
Profile pictures, post images, and post videos all resolve correctly from blob data
No console errors related to invalid blob/object URLs

file_operations.description: Ensure that when an ExternalBlob avatarUrl or profilePicture is present, it is rendered using avatarUrl.getDirectURL() as the img src attribute. Verify that the component correctly handles ExternalBlob instances and does not attempt to use them as strings directly. Add null/undefined checks before calling getDirectURL(). Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.

Fix video thumbnail and playback by ensuring the video src is set using post.media?.getDirectURL(). Add null checks for post.media before rendering the video element. Ensure that the video element correctly displays the thumbnail/poster and that play/pause controls work. Verify the blob-storage component's usage instructions before implementing.
